findings.title: RLS policy open_users allows every row
findings.explanation: This policy does not tie access to the signed-in user. Restrict rows with an explicit ownership or role condition before exposing the table.

evidence.snippet: RLS policy open_users has a permissive or missing identity condition.

findings.title: Migration deletes rows without a WHERE clause
findings.explanation: An unbounded delete can remove every row in production. Add an explicit predicate or move the operation into a reviewed backfill.

findings.title: Environment file is committed
findings.explanation: Committed environment files can expose production credentials. Remove the file from version control and rotate any real credentials it contains.

evidence.snippet: Committed environment file detected; values are hidden.

findings.title: Supabase table public.users has RLS disabled
findings.explanation: Supabase tables exposed through the Data API should have row-level security enabled. Add an RLS migration and policies for intended access.

evidence.snippet: create table public.users (id uuid primary key, email text);

findings.title: Migration drops an existing database object
findings.explanation: Dropping tables or columns can irreversibly remove production data. Use a staged migration and confirm backups before applying it.

findings.title: Vulnerable dependency lodash@4.17.20
findings.explanation: Lodash version 4.17.20 has a known security advisory in this offline fixture. Upgrade to 4.17.21 or later.

findings.title: Public API route has no visible rate limit
findings.explanation: Unauthenticated routes can be called repeatedly. Add a per-IP or per-account limit to reduce brute force and resource abuse.

evidence.snippet: Public API route app/api/users/route.ts has no visible rate limiter.

findings.title: API handler has no visible auth guard
findings.explanation: This public handler has no recognizable authentication check. Verify the caller before returning data or changing state.

evidence.snippet: Exported API handler at app/api/users/route.ts:1. No auth guard was found in this file.

findings.title: Dynamic code execution with eval
findings.explanation: `eval` executes text as code and can turn untrusted input into an arbitrary code path. Replace it with explicit parsing or a fixed function map.

findings.title: No error tracking service was detected
findings.explanation: Without error tracking, production exceptions can go unnoticed. Add a server-side error reporting integration or document the platform integration.

findings.title: No structured logging was detected
findings.explanation: Structured logs make production failures easier to search and correlate. Add a logger that records event names and useful request context.

findings.title: No test files were detected
findings.explanation: Tests catch regressions before deploys. Add focused unit tests for core business rules and one integration test for a critical path.

findings.title: No CI configuration was detected
findings.explanation: Automated checks help catch broken builds and tests before they reach production. Add a CI workflow that runs typecheck, lint, tests, and build.

findings.title: Dependency next is not pinned to an exact version
findings.explanation: The manifest uses ^15.1.0, which may resolve to different releases. Pin an exact version and update the lockfile through the package manager.

fix.description: Pin next to the version recorded in the lockfile.
fix.patch:
Index: package.json
===================================================================
--- package.json	before
+++ package.json	after
@@ -1,9 +1,9 @@
 {
   "name": "mixed-fixture",
   "private": true,
   "dependencies": {
-    "next": "^15.1.0",
+    "next": "15.1.4",
     "react": "~19.0.0",
     "lodash": "4.17.20"
   }
 }

findings.title: Request body has no visible schema validation
findings.explanation: Malformed or unexpected input can reach application logic. Validate the request against a Zod, Joi, Valibot, or equivalent schema before using it.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy
findings.explanation: The repository configuration does not set Content-Security-Policy. Add it at the app or hosting layer to reduce browser-side attack risk.

evidence.snippet: No Content-Security-Policy setting was found in detected configuration files.

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors
findings.explanation: The repository configuration does not set X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors. Add it at the app or hosting layer to reduce browser-side attack risk.

evidence.snippet: No X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors setting was found in detected configuration files.

findings.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security
findings.explanation: The repository configuration does not set Strict-Transport-Security. Add it at the app or hosting layer to reduce browser-side attack risk.

evidence.snippet: No Strict-Transport-Security setting was found in detected configuration files.

findings.title: No health endpoint was detected
findings.explanation: A lightweight health route gives hosting and monitoring systems a safe way to confirm the app is running.

fix.description: Add a lightweight Next.js health endpoint.
